text: The highest bid is never updated.

I fixed the bug in `src/auction-api/BidService.ts`. `placeBid` never recorded an accepted bid on the item, so the next bid was still checked against the starting price. A second bid of 100 passed because 100 is above the starting price of 50.

Now an accepted bid sets `item.highestBidAmount` and `item.highestBidderId` before `saveItem` runs. The existing minimum check, which already required the highest bid plus 1, now applies to every later bid.

I didn't run the test itself. `typecheck` and `detect_drift` are both clean, and I didn't run `start_app` because the change doesn't touch the wiring.
